body:

author: sarach06
body:
Hi Val, 
I can see that that PTHR34846 (it is not integrated in InterPro) includes only these two SwissProt proteins: Uncharacterized protein YdfG and Uncharacterized protein YnjA. IPR004675 (including the TIGR00778 model) is specific for Alkylhydroperoxidase AhpD and papers PMID:12761216 describes it as having alkylhydroperoxidase activity on its own, also involved in the reduction of alkylhydroperoxidase AhpC in the case of Mycobacterium tuberculosis. According to PMID:31974167, lpg0406 has peroxidase activity and involved in antioxidant defense, however, the homologue from Streptococcus pneumoniae contributes to pneumococcal virulence and oxidative stress responses. It has weak thiol-dependent peroxidase activity and, unlike the Mycobacterium tuberculosis AhpC/D system, SpAhpD does not mediate electron transfer to SpAhpC PMID:26402328.

So, I will leave only GO:0032843 in IPR004675. Do you agree with this?

Thanks!
Best wishes
Sara
